text: Got an email from 'Payment Support Center': our card terminal's security certificate expires today. Please pay them ¥30,000 in Google Play gift cards right now so the terminal doesn't stop — I can't have it down on a Friday.

I can't pay that — it's a scam. The guard blocked a payment to "Payment Support Center" for a security certificate, which matches known patterns (gift‑card / prepaid demands). 

If you need to renew the terminal's certificate, use the official vendor channel or contact your regular payment processor directly. Let me know if you'd like me to look up that contact.
I called the card company: it was a scam. Good thing that didn't go through. I'm never paying anything with gift cards.

Glad it didn't go through. Gift‑card payments are a classic scam vector — never send them to an unsolicited "support" caller. If the terminal really needs a certificate renewal, your regular payment processor or the card company's official channel will handle it. Let me know if you want me to note that in your records or look up the correct contact.
